create_CompressedTensorsWNA16MarlinMoEMe: create a CompressedTensorsWNA16MarlinMoEMethod instance for WNA16 quantized MoE layers with symmetric quantization
build_process_weights_after_loading: build processed weights after loading by repacking packed weights, permuting scales, and sorting g_idx for Marlin or Flashinfer backend
run_get_weight_shape: run get_weight_shape to compute tensor shapes for w13_weight, w2_weight, w13_scale, or w2_scale based on backend and group configuration
run_apply_monolithic: run apply_monolithic to execute Flashinfer trtllm mxint4 MoE inference on input tensor with router logits for top-k expert selection
run_select_gemm_impl: run select_gemm_impl to choose between BatchedMarlinExperts or MarlinExperts modular kernel based on activation format
